# Vendored: Sneat Bootstrap HTML Admin Template – Free v3.0.0

- Source: https://github.com/themeselection/sneat-html-admin-template-free (v3.0.0)
- License: MIT, © ThemeSelection — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Attribution is kept here and in the app footer.

What we use:

- `scss/` – Sneat's SCSS (Bootstrap 5.3 extended + layout/menu components), compiled by Vite.
  Only `scss/_custom-variables/_bootstrap-extended.scss` is modified, with the WCAG AA colour
  overrides from `docs/design/THEME_TOKENS.md`.
- `icons.css` – the Boxicons this app uses (Boxicons 2.1.4, MIT, © Atisa, https://boxicons.com),
  as CSS mask rules with inline SVGs. Generated by `apps/web/scripts/build-icon-subset.mjs` from
  Sneat's `assets/vendor/fonts/iconify-icons.css`, which holds the full Boxicons set (bx, bxs, bxl);
  a gzipped copy is kept in `apps/web/scripts/vendor/` so the script runs offline. It includes every
  `bx-`/`bxs-`/`bxl-` class used in `src` plus `icons.required.json`, and
  `src/test/icons.test.ts` fails if a used class has no rule (DR-12). Don't edit `icons.css` by
  hand: use the class, then run `node apps/web/scripts/build-icon-subset.mjs`.

Not shipped: Sneat's HTML pages, jQuery, menu.js/main.js, and other page scripts. Layout behaviour
(sidebar toggle, dropdowns) is implemented in React.
